audit.why: 55.17% over 261 games. Both layers hand levels 1-2 to skill and everything from 3 onward to Cassiopeia, which matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere, and Mantra's availability was treated as a fixed timer.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12s flat, Inspire is 10s at rank 1, and Mantra is 40s at rank 1 — but Gathering Fire reduces Mantra's cooldown every time one of her damaging abilities lands. Her ult spike is therefore something you control by dodging Inner Flame, which is a real, actionable spike fact the page did not have.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the Gathering Fire mechanic written into content.early, content.mid, full.breakdown.cooldowns and full.loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate lines (wants.you[0], whys[3], spikes[2].text) told the player Miasma's grounding stops Karma from dashing away — 'so she cannot E-dash or speed out'. Karma has no dash. Inspire is a shield plus a move speed buff.
audit.why: Riot: Inspire 'summons a protective shield that absorbs incoming damage and increases the Move Speed of the protected ally'. Grounding blocks movement abilities, not move speed buffs, so the advice was resting on an ability Karma does not own. What actually fights Inspire is Miasma's slow. Separately, Focused Resolve only roots if the 675-unit tether survives, and Noxious Blast grants Cassiopeia move speed on champion hit which Serpentine Grace amplifies — that is the concrete escape the page never named.
audit.corrected: All three lines now sell Miasma's slow against Inspire's speed, and the tether-break interaction is written into content.mid, full.report[5].t and full.loading.

audit.why: Riot: Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve 'heals herself and extends the root duration'. In a lane decided by extended poison trades, that heal is the thing Grievous Wounds is for.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called Karma 'he' and 'his' throughout — tldr, report[0].t, ahead, report[13].t, dosFull[1].t, dontsFull[0].t.
audit.why: Karma is female. Pronoun errors on the summary line are the first thing a reader sees.

edits.before: Karma's Q is her only real early damage and it is a slow, telegraphed line — sidestep it and you eat almost no poke while you last-hit. Level 1 is a true skill check: you have one ability and no poison stacking yet, so don't greed a trade. From level 2-3 you flip it — prime her with Q poison, then chained Twin Fangs and your own W-grounding let you out-DPS her single Q. Respect her E: it shields a chunk of your burst, so unload when it is on cooldown, not the instant she pops it.
edits.after: Karma's Inner Flame is her only real early damage and it is a slow, telegraphed line at 950 range — sidestep it and you eat almost no poke while you last-hit. Level 1 is a true skill check: you have one ability and no poison stacking, so don't greed a trade. From level 2-3 you flip it — prime her with Q poison, then chain Twin Fang to out-DPS her single Q. Respect Inspire: the shield eats a chunk of your burst, so unload on its 10-second cooldown, not the instant she pops it.

edits.before: This is your lane to take. Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fangs once she is poisoned, and her squishy enchanter body melts to ramping poison she has no way to out-trade. Her lockdown is her W tether and her Mantra-Q (Soulflare) snare — both need her to step up and face you, so bait them or W-ground her first, then unload. At 6 your Petrifying Gaze stuns her through that step-up and turns any won trade into a kill; she cannot pool, dash, or steroid out of it the way a bruiser could.
edits.after: This is your lane to take. Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fang once she is poisoned, and her squishy enchanter body melts to ramping poison. Her lockdown is Focused Resolve (W, 12s) and the Mantra-Q snare — both need her to step up and face you. The tether only roots if it survives: Noxious Blast speeds you up on champion hit and Serpentine Grace amplifies it, so poison her and walk the tether past its 675-unit leash. At 6, Petrifying Gaze stuns her through that step-up and she has no dash to leave on.

notes: The fabricated 'E-dash' was the big one — Karma has no dash at all, so a player holding a 24-second Miasma to stop one was throwing the lane's best cooldown away every time. Left the phase 'why' strings alone: they are champion-wide boilerplate that names neither Karma nor any of her abilities, identical to the Jax and Jayce rows. Also left full.winCon / enemyWin / breakdown.trading, which still render her W as 'Focused Resolve (Tether)' — the parenthetical is redundant but not wrong, and rewriting five near-duplicate template strings for style alone risks length rejections for no factual gain.
